reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in a #central-team thread. I couldn't confirm that Bay 15 is the site for the Jasper rollout at Marrow Fieldworks. Nothing he can see mentions the rollout or Bay 15. I checked the #central-team history and the shared Central files.

The only Marrow Fieldworks site detail I found is in the 5 Jan 2026 handoff digest. It mentions Bay 4 at the Salina North yard, but in connection with support ticket #4409, not a rollout.

In the thread I said Bay 15 stays unconfirmed until someone on the account confirms it, and I asked Hollis or Pree to post the actual site.
